chunks: 209/3 - Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Sukkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: al-Abbas ibn Bakkar narrated to us. He said: Harb ibn Maymun narrated to us, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), who said:

When Fatima gave birth to al-Hasan (peace be upon them both), she said to Ali (peace be upon him): Name him. He said: I would not precede the Messenger of God in naming him. Then the Messenger of God came, and the child was brought to him in a yellow cloth. He said: Had I not forbidden you from wrapping him in yellow cloth? Then he cast it aside and took a white cloth and wrapped him in it. Then he said to Ali: Have you named him? He said: I did not wish to precede you. So he said: And I do not wish to precede my Lord, Mighty and Majestic. So God revealed to Jibra'il. Jibra'il descended and congratulated him from God. Then he said: God commands you to name him with the name of the son of Harun. He said: And what was his name? He said: Shabbar. He said: My tongue is Arabic. He said: Name him al-Hasan. So he named him al-Hasan.

And when al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was born, God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Jibra'il that a son had been born to Muhammad, so descend to him and congratulate him. He said: So Jibra'il descended and congratulated him from God, Blessed and Exalted. Then he said: Indeed, Ali is to you in the position of Harun to Musa, so name him with the name of the son of Harun. He said: And what is his name? He said: Shubayr. He said: My tongue is Arabic. He said: Name him al-Husayn. So he named him al-Husayn.

key_terms.بمنزلة هارون من موسى: In the position of Harun to Musa -- a reference to the famous hadith of manzilah establishing Ali's rank relative to the Prophet
key_terms.خرقة صفراء: Yellow cloth -- wrapping a newborn in yellow was disapproved by the Prophet, who preferred white
key_terms.شبر: Shabbar -- the Hebrew name of the eldest son of the Prophet Harun (Aaron), arabicized as al-Hasan
key_terms.شبير: Shubayr -- the Hebrew name of the second son of the Prophet Harun (Aaron), arabicized as al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: How were Imam al-Hasan and Imam al-Husayn named?
ai.summary: This narrative from Imam al-Sajjad (AS) recounts the divinely guided naming of Imam al-Hasan and Imam al-Husayn (AS). When each was born, neither Imam Ali nor the Prophet would name the child without God's instruction. God sent the angel Jibra'il with the command to name them after the sons of the Prophet Harun (Aaron) -- Shabbar and Shubayr in Hebrew -- arabicized as al-Hasan and al-Husayn. The hadith underscores the parallel between Ali and the Prophet, echoing the famous hadith of manzilah (the position of Harun to Musa), and establishes that the names of the grandsons of the Prophet were divinely chosen.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. `Ali al Sikri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: al-`Abbas b. Bikar narrated to us. He said: Harb b. Maymun narrated to us from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali from Zayd b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn (as). He said:

Fatima begot al-Hasan (as) and said to `Ali (as): Name him. He said: I do not want to precede the Messenger of Allah in naming him.  Then, the Messenger of Allah (s) came and he was brought to him in a yellow rag. He said: Had I not forbidden you from bundling him in yellow (cloth)? Then he cast it aside and took a white rag and wrapped him in it. Then he said to `Ali (as): Have you named him? He said: I did not wish to precede you in naming him. So, he (s) said: And I do not wish to precede my Lord in naming him. So, Allah revealed to Jibra’il that a son had been born to Muhammad. Descend and convey the salaam to him and congratulate him. And say to him: Surely, `Ali is to you in the position of Harun to Musa; so mark him with the name of the son of Harun. So Jibra’il (as) descended and congratulated him from Allah. Then he said: Allah commands you to call him by the name of the son of Harun. He said: And what was his name? He said: Shabar. He said: My tongue is Arabic. He said: Name him al-Hasan. So, he named him al-Hasan.

When Husayn (as) was born, Allah revealed to Jibra’il that a son had been born to Muhammad. So, descend towards him and congratulate him, and say to him: Surely, `Ali is to you in the position of Harun to Musa; so mark him with the name of the son of Harun. He said: So Jibra’il descended and congratulated him from Allah. Then he said: Surely, `Ali is to you in the position of Harun to Musa; so mark him with the name of the son of Harun. He said: And what was his name? He said: Shubayr. He said: My tongue is Arabic. He said: Name him al-Husayn. So, he named him al Husayn.
